contracts.optIn: Immutable rangeEditing original/general-v1 is independent from explicit/typing-v1 history and richLanguage 1/2/3. Local/shared vanilla and React roots require a complete paired native capability for general mode. Parent renders cannot silently change an owner's replay policy.
contracts.records: General records use breditor/shared-general-checkpoint-record version1 with exactly checkpointJson, format, formatVersion, history and richLanguage. Existing exact strings and original typing record shapes remain unchanged. Original restore callbacks retain exactly two arguments; general records explicitly supply the third range policy.
contracts.admission: Stored general records require matching range/language options and explicit natural history when selected. JS checks family/identity, never substitutes AST import for native replay. Ordinary general journals lack a language header; the selected Rust profile proves actual schema/model admission. A tampered outer language label was rejected by real Wasm without replacing the durable value.
contracts.recovery: Explicit generalCheckpoint/generalTypingCheckpoint seeds choose matching restore factories and policy defaults. Stored records still take precedence. Legacy upgrades retain content, old Undo units and Redo; an aborted upgrade leaves the old durable record intact. Failed close retires publications but retains exact readable history and the writer lease for retry. New recovery producers expose independent rangePolicy/historyPolicy.
contracts.routing: Observed shared general mode or explicit immutable local general mode retains cross-cell native text endpoints. Explicit cell-picker grids stay separate. Plain typing/replacement, selected deletion, Shift+Enter and plain paste use closed native targets and fresh namespaces. Same-caret browser targets retain logical affinity; adjacent same-block natural deletion retains original grouping. No temporary target selection or JS AST rewrite is introduced.
contracts.compatibility: Original defaults, factories, stored strings/typing records, causal models, frame meanings and writer digest guards retain their existing contracts. Local checkpoints retain their original ordinary/natural families; hosts explicitly reapply the controller option on reopen.
